body:
Hello,

Counters such as `temporal_workflow_completed_total` only appears when they're incremented, which leads to [all sorts of issues](https://www.robustperception.io/existential-issues-with-metrics/).

While some of this can be mitigated on the Prometheus query side (like the alerting part), it's pretty cumbersome to do, and every users of the SDK might stumble upon this issue and will have to fix this themselves.

comments.body:
Thanks for the PR and for the detailed write-up. I’m going to close this because we don’t want the SDK to pre-initialize workflow outcome counters at worker startup.

In most metrics systems, a labeled counter is not emitted until a value is recorded for that exact label set. That is expected behavior. Predeclaring these four counters would only partially address the issue because many SDK metrics have labels that are not knowable until runtime, like activity type, worker type, failure reason, poller type, or other outcome-specific tags. 

Handling missing series should live in the metrics collection/query/alerting layer, where expected-but-not-yet-observed series can be defaulted or zero-filled consistently. Adding SDK-side zero emissions here would create Go-specific behavior, increase cardinality, and still leave the same class of problem for other metrics.

title: Metric counters only appear when they're incremented
